verses.mystical_translation: Creation itself is imagined as responsive to liberation.
The poem enters through exodus, sea, jordan, allowing what is real to be named before it is transformed.
Its center asks what becomes possible when memory, power, vulnerability, and desire are held in the presence of the Divine rather than acted out automatically.
